findings.title: SQL Injection em /rest/user/login
findings.description: Endpoint POST /rest/user/login vulnerável a SQL Injection no parâmetro 'email'. Payload ' OR '1'='1' -- realiza autenticação bypass, permitindo login como qualquer usuário (admin confirmado). CWE-89 (SQL Injection). Impacto: escalada de privilégio, acesso não autorizado. CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H = 9.8 (CRÍTICO).
steps: Receber HTTP 200 com JWT válido de admin (id:1, role:admin)
Usar JWT para acessar endpoints administrativos

Acessou: http://localhost:3000/api/Complaints → HTTP 200, 1 registro(s) exposto(s) (listagem de reclamações internas)

Servidor aceitou JWT com payload adulterado (assinatura inválida). Role retornado: undefined

findings.title: [ZAP] Content Security Policy (CSP) Header Not Set
findings.description: Content Security Policy (CSP) is an added layer of security that helps to detect and mitigate certain types of attacks, including Cross Site Scripting (XSS) and data injection attacks. These attacks are used for everything from data theft to site defacement or distribution of malware. CSP provides a set of standard HTTP headers that allow website owners to declare approved sources of content that browsers should be allowed to load on that page — covered types are JavaScript, CSS, HTML frames, fonts, images and embeddable objects such as Java applets, ActiveX, audio and video files. | CWE-693 | WASC-15
steps: Solução: Ensure that your web server, application server, load balancer, etc. is configured to set the Content-Security-Policy header.

findings.title: [ZAP] Private IP Disclosure
findings.description: A private IP (such as 10.x.x.x, 172.x.x.x, 192.168.x.x) or an Amazon EC2 private hostname (for example, ip-10-0-56-78) has been found in the HTTP response body. This information might be helpful for further attacks targeting internal systems. | CWE-497 | WASC-13
steps: Solução: Remove the private IP address from the HTTP response body. For comments, use JSP/ASP/PHP comment instead of HTML/JavaScript comment which can be seen by client browsers.

findings.title: [ZAP] Re-examine Cache-control Directives
findings.description: The cache-control header has not been set properly or is missing, allowing the browser and proxies to cache content. For static assets like css, js, or image files this might be intended, however, the resources should be reviewed to ensure that no sensitive content will be cached. | CWE-525 | WASC-13
steps: Solução: For secure content, ensure the cache-control HTTP header is set with "no-cache, no-store, must-revalidate". If an asset should be cached consider setting the directives "public, max-age, immutable".

findings.title: [ZAP] Strict-Transport-Security Header Not Set
findings.description: HTTP Strict Transport Security (HSTS) is a web security policy mechanism whereby a web server declares that complying user agents (such as a web browser) are to interact with it using only secure HTTPS connections (i.e. HTTP layered over TLS/SSL). HSTS is an IETF standards track protocol and is specified in RFC 6797. | CWE-319 | WASC-15
steps: Solução: Ensure that your web server, application server, load balancer, etc. is configured to enforce Strict-Transport-Security.

findings.title: [ZAP] Session Management Response Identified
findings.description: The given response has been identified as containing a session management token. The 'Other Info' field contains a set of header tokens that can be used in the Header Based Session Management Method. If the request is in a context which has a Session Management Method set to "Auto-Detect" then this rule will change the session management to use the tokens identified. | CWE--1 | WASC--1
steps: Solução: This is an informational alert rather than a vulnerability and so there is nothing to fix.

findings.title: [ZAP] Application Error Disclosure

findings.title: [ZAP] Information Disclosure - Debug Error Messages

steps: Solução: Disable debugging messages before pushing to production.

.gg não passa. Validação de extensão está funcionando, mas há caminho para bypass — path traversal ou null byte. Testar path traversal: /ftp/../arquivos ou /ftp/encrypt.pyc%00.md (null byte em PHP < 5.3, se backend vulnerável).
Null byte rejeitado (Express moderno). Path traversal simples — testar /ftp/..%2fencrypt.pyc ou /ftp/encrypt.pyc com HTTP verb tampering (HEAD, OPTIONS).

Path traversal bloqueado. Validação está protegendo bem. Focar em arquivos .md/.pdf que já listei — acquisitions.md, legal.md confirmados. Passei por recon /ftp. Agora devo testar categorias OWASP (§2). Prioridade: (1) Broken Access Control (IDOR), (2) Mass Assignment, (3) Injection, (4) JWT Attacks, (5) Business Logic.

Começar com endpoints da API — o AppMap menciona /rest/order-history retorna 500 sem auth. IDOR potencial. Testar com JWT de usuário autenticado.

500 com "Blocked illegal activity by IP" — anti-cheat system detectado. Vaza arquivo `/juice-shop/build/routes/orderHistory.js` e `/juice-shop/build/lib/antiCheat.js`. CWE-209 (Information Exposure Through Error Message). O anti-cheat está bloqueando requisições suspeitas por IP. Estratégia: mudar User-Agent, adicionar headers realistas, ou esperar. Testar outros endpoints primeiro para mapear superfície.

Próximo: testar `/rest/user/whoami?fields=...` — AppMap mostra que retorna 200 sem auth. Possível parameter pollution / information leak.
whoami sem autenticação retorna usuário vazio (não autenticado). Testar com JWT — adicionar Authorization header.

Mesmo com JWT, whoami retorna vazio. JWT pode estar expirado ou o servidor não aceita "Bearer" — pode usar cookie. Testar extrair tokens via extract_tokens para obter cookie/JWT válido da sessão atual.

SQL INJECTION CONFIRMADA — payload ' OR '1'='1' -- logou como admin (id:1, role:admin). CWE-89 (SQL Injection). Retornou JWT válido de admin. Isso é CRITICAL — Broken Authentication via SQL Injection.

JWT decodado (payload):
{
  "status": "success",
  "data": {
    "id": 1,
    "email": "admin@juice-sh.op",
    "password": "0192023a7bbd73250516f069df18b500",
    "role": "admin",
    ...
  },
  "iat": 1785686476
}

Encontrei:
1. **SQL Injection em /rest/user/login** — CWE-89 — CRITICAL (RCE via SQL injection ou escalada direta para admin).
2. **Sensitive Data Exposure** — hash de senha em JWT — CWE-200.

Próximo: testar este JWT em endpoints administrativos. Registrar finding e continuar cobertura de categorias.

Primeiro finding crítico registrado. Agora usar JWT admin para testar outros endpoints e descobrir mais vulnerabilidades. Prioridade: (1) Broken Access Control (IDOR), (2) Mass Assignment, (3) Business Logic, (4) XSS. Vou testar /rest/admin/* e /rest/users/* com JWT admin.

Testar GET /rest/users com JWT admin para enumerar usuários.
/rest/users não existe. Testar /api/Users (CamelCase) com GET.

Endpoint /api/Users retorna lista COMPLETA de usuários com todos os campos (id, email, role, deluxeToken, profileImage, timestamps). CWE-200 (Sensitive Data Exposure) — não há paginação ou proteção de massa de dados. IDOR potencial em GET /api/Users/:id. Testar acesso a usuário específico.
GET /api/Users/2 funciona com admin JWT — dados de jim retornados. Testar IDOR: GET /api/Users/2 SEM autenticação.
GET /api/Users/2 sem JWT retorna 401 — autorização está sendo verificada. Testar Mass Assignment: PATCH /api/Users/2 como admin, tentando alterar role ou isActive.
